methodology.timing: one complete untimed warmup fixture, then monotonic wall time for each fresh fixture after forced GC
methodology.allocation: post-run store-owned allocated bytes plus evaluator peak transient matrix bytes and matrix allocation count for each timed fixture
methodology.correctness: every warmup and measured fixture is checked against the workload's exact expected output before its sample is accepted

gates.tolerance: exact matrix/output/provenance; raw summaries derived; timing median/p95 <= max(baseline*1.25, baseline+0.1ms); no attributed allocation or aggregate WASM regression
